## Scope
This file applies to `papers/graphical_abstracts`.

## Directory contract
Source-owned conceptual graphical abstracts, vector/raster exports and one portable source/output identity receipt; no numerical or empirical results.

## Working rules
- Use `uv` for Python commands and dependency-managed execution.
- Keep changes local to this directory's responsibility unless a shared API contract requires a coordinated edit.
- Preserve generated artifacts only when they are intentional and reproducible; remove bytecode, caches, and OS metadata.
- When editing manuscript prose, keep scientific claims source-backed and soften or cite claims that are not directly supported.
- Update marked source-owned guides through `tools/ensure_folder_docs.py --refresh --check`, not by editing generated text.

uv run python tools/generate_graphical_abstracts.py --output cache/graphical-abstracts-review
